groupPolicy.default: Local ComputerGroupPolicyObject section registry, DWORD write/delete, GPO Save after mutation
groupPolicy.reset: Delete named policy value, not write an opposite constant; GPO deletion is gated by a direct-registry existence check
groupPolicy.needsIndependentImplementation: Detect effective policy, preserve prior local policy entry and live value, and bind scope/SID. Never infer runtime effect merely from successful write.
groupPolicy.exitAction: GPUpdate.exe /force when any group-policy control changed

ordinaryRegistry.readFailure: Missing/wrong-type/permission results can be treated as absent by WPD UI
ordinaryRegistry.onAccessDenied: WPD attempts ownership/ACL grant; native implementation should report precise denial and preserve ACLs unless explicitly reviewed

service.fallback: On WMI ChangeStartMode return 2 writes Start directly
service.userServiceReset: Writes base template Start in ControlSet001 to raw vendor default; skips live-instance restart/default handling

initialization.nativeDecision: Detection must remain non-mutating. Defaults are optional explicit choices.

firewallGlobalControl.enable: Ensure MpsSvc auto/running, set Domain/Private/Public enabled
firewallGlobalControl.disable: Disable Domain/Private/Public profiles; Vista/Win7 additionally attempts stop/disable MpsSvc. Newer Windows leaves MpsSvc running.
firewallGlobalControl.nativeDecision: Independent address blocking retains Windows Firewall. Expose global toggles only with separate explicit review and recovery.

restorePoint.nativeDecision: Reuse existing backup provider and disclose any frequency-setting change.

providerSemantics.ownedRuleIdentity: Use this app's rule IDs; do not remove WPD or unrelated rules by substring.

otherFeatures.restore: Reinstall is not exact user-data restoration; preserve package identity/dependencies/data and disclose limits.
otherFeatures.vendorCompletionLimit: Wrapper starts asynchronous removal without awaiting deployment-operation completion; native implementation must await final deployment result.
otherFeatures.vendorRestoreAction: Open https://wpd.app in browser; no package/data restoration

otherFeatures.notes: Constructor.json contains four examples; custom arbitrary targets are not a finite shipped-tweak inventory.
